artmathematics.name: Art & Mathematics: Visual Philosophy
artmathematics.truth: Art makes visible what mathematics proves. The impossible staircase is Gödel you can climb.
artmathematics.qfep_connection: Artists have visualized QFEP dynamics for centuries—Escher's impossible objects (edge of formal systems), Magritte's sign/signified gap, Minimalism's dark room paradox. Art embodies theory before theory names itself.
artmathematics.description: From Escher's impossible staircases to Magritte's treachery of images to Minimalism's meaning-evacuation paradox. Art as visual epistemology—making mathematical and philosophical limits tangible.
learning_objectives: Escher: locally coherent, globally impossible—visual Gödel
Magritte: the sign is not the signified—representation has limits
Constructivism: meaning-free elements in autonomous arrangements
Minimalism paradox: signs signify despite meaning-evacuation
